column1: So you think your only choice during a long layover or a flight delay is to suffer in the airport terminal? Think again. But be prepared to pay handsomely one way or another for the alternative. The airline lounge competition is heating up around the globe, and two new entrants, American and United, have, somewhat belatedly, become serious contenders. Like the difference between first-class and economy seats, the luxury lounges offered by many major airlines are yet another way in which air travel is separating the haves from the have-nots.
